name: Mikoyan MiG-25 Foxbat
affiliation: Soviet Air Defense Forces (PVO) / Russian Air Force
role: Mach 3.2 High-Altitude Supersonic Strategic Interceptor & Reconnaissance

avionics.radarName: RP-25 Smerch-A2 High-Power Vacuum-Tube Radar (600 kW pulse power)

airToAirMissiles: 4 × R-40R/T Heavy High-Altitude BVR Missiles (Mach 4.5, 60km range)
precisionGuidedBombs: 8 × 500kg Heat-Resistant FAB-500T Bombs dropped from Mach 2.5+

strengths: High-thrust propulsion envelope with supersonic dash and high G-tolerance
limitations: Conventional radar cross-section vulnerable to modern integrated air defense (IADS)
Legacy mechanical radar architecture with limited electronic warfare counter-countermeasures
Restricted combat radius requiring aerial refueling support for deep penetration

intelligenceDossier.summary: Constructed primarily of 80% nickel-steel alloy and titanium to resist 300°C friction heat at Mach 3.2, the MiG-25 remains the fastest production combat aircraft in history.
intelligenceDossier.historicalContext: Its appearance prompted the United States to develop the F-15 Eagle; Lt. Viktor Belenko famously defected with a MiG-25P to Japan in 1976.
intelligenceDossier.tacticalDoctrine: Mach 3 high-altitude dash at 80,000 feet, firing massive 1,000-lb R-40 missiles against high-altitude reconnaissance targets like the SR-71 and B-58 Hustler.

sources: National Ministry of Defense Verified Inventories
